summary: Layer 1B expands the node from obvious data-center power/cooling leaders into less-obvious public-market proxies. The main underfollowed lane is not GPU/server vendors, but firms tied to site energization, medium-voltage switchgear, liquid/air thermal systems, electrical installation, and physical infrastructure durability. Current evidence supports Powell Industries and Modine as direct equipment beneficiaries, AZZ as a second-order infrastructure-materials proxy, and Vertiv as the high-attention reference anchor. Claims are research leads only, not trading recommendations.
